_readme: Curated directory for the Local Brief. Edit entries here, then load them with: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/ingest/organizations.mjs. Nothing appears on the site until its "verified" is true. Keep descriptions neutral and factual; put a group's own stance in stated_position, quoted or closely paraphrased from its own materials, or null if it has none. county_fips: null = statewide, or a list of 5-digit county codes. kind: ratepayer_advocate | utility_commission | local_government | community_group | environmental_group | civic_group | industry_group | other.

organizations.name: Alaska Department of Law, Regulatory Affairs & Public Advocacy
organizations.description: Alaska's public advocate in utility cases before the Regulatory Commission of Alaska, part of the Department of Law's Civil Division.
organizations.curated_by: Claude: name and website from the NARUC/NASUCA directory, site checked live on 2026-10-24

organizations.name: Regulatory Commission of Alaska
organizations.description: Alaska's utility regulator. It approves the rates investor-owned utilities charge, including how the cost of serving big new customers such as data centers is shared among everyone else. Its rate cases are open to public comment. City-owned utilities and electric cooperatives may set their own rates instead, so check which kind of company sends your bill.
